doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His parents and five siblings
summary: Names his mother Pearl Gonzales, his father Jesse Hamilton, and his siblings including Orean, Bernie the actor and Don.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well let’s back up. I don’t want to get all that far away. Let’s go back.
Okay.
You mentioned that your mother was a dietician.
Yeah.
If we could just get your parents names.
Okay. Her name was Pearl Gonzales.
Pearl Gonzales was your mother’s name.
And my father was Jesse.
Jesse Hamilton.
Hamilton.
Okay. And you mentioned an older brother. How many siblings do you have?
It was six of us all together. My sister just passed away as a matter of fact. My brother Bernie, the actor, do you know him?
Bernie Hamilton?
Do you know Bernie Hamilton, the actor?
Oh, the name, sure. I don’t know him personally.
My younger brother. My older brother was Orean.
How do you spell that?
O-R-E-A-N, Orean Thomas. My sister was the oldest.
She was the oldest, okay.
Jesselee Orean, and then me, Foreststorn, and next was Adair, and Bernie, Renaldo, and my baby brother is Don, Don Wesley.
